tasks.title: Global burned area comparison
tasks.description: Aggregate GFED5 burned area on the native grid and a conservative 2° × 2.5° grid, then compare against GFED4.1s and four existing ML scenario predictions. The report covers 1997–2026 and tracks incomplete months.

tasks.title: Burned area across four SSPs
tasks.description: Reconstruct and project global burned area through 2100 using CESM2 climate, LUH2 land use and human population density. The paired GFED4.1s and GFED5 definitions use conservative remapping. Gallery diagnostics document the early Example 10 configuration.

tasks.title: Station wet deposition
tasks.description: Use ERA5, CAM wet deposition, emissions and socioeconomic predictors to predict station NH₄⁺ and NO₃⁻ targets and infer on a 0.25° grid with the historical Fire_Ndep station configuration.

tasks.title: Gridded fire and non-fire nitrogen deposition
tasks.description: Inference on the global monthly CAM f19 grid using ERA5 and CAM emissions and deposition predictors. The selected project configuration reuses fitted models and the feature archive for its 2023 prediction window.

tasks.title: Zhao et al. (2025) burned-area workflow
tasks.description: Reproduce the burned-area workflow using GFED4.1s, one CESM2 member, XGBoost, leave-one-year-out validation and two SSPs. The experiment notes document differences in climate inputs and bias correction from the paper.

tasks.title: Cropland N₂O mitigation
tasks.description: Frozen training and inference workflows for direct and indirect cropland nitrogen losses. Reproduction uses the original training tables, staged prediction inputs and paper model checkpoints.

gallery.title: Global burned area comparison
gallery.description: Global monthly and annual burned area from GFED4.1s, GFED5 including NRT and existing ML predictions for four SSPs. Annual totals require all 12 months.
gallery.alt: Line charts of monthly and annual global burned area from GFED4.1s, GFED5 and ML predictions.

gallery.title: Mean burned area by SSP
gallery.description: Mean predicted burned area for SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5 from the frozen Example 10 run.
gallery.note: The 0831 experiment used non-conservative remapping of the burned-area label. Use this figure to inspect the archived workflow. The current 2° × 2.5° experiments use conservative remapping.
gallery.alt: Four global maps of mean predicted burned area for the four SSPs.

gallery.title: Spatial bias in holdout burned area
gallery.description: Mean difference between the SSP2-4.5 prediction and the GFED4.1s reference at each grid cell in the holdout period of the frozen Example 10 run.
gallery.note: The 0831 experiment used non-conservative remapping of the burned-area label. Use this figure to inspect the archived workflow. The current 2° × 2.5° experiments use conservative remapping.
gallery.alt: Global map of predicted minus reference burned area in the SSP2-4.5 holdout period.

gallery.title: Feature effects on burned area predictions
gallery.description: SHAP value distributions for the burned-area model under SSP1-2.6 from the frozen Example 10 run.
gallery.note: The 0831 experiment used non-conservative remapping of the burned-area label. Use this figure to inspect the archived workflow. The current 2° × 2.5° experiments use conservative remapping.
gallery.alt: SHAP beeswarm showing the contributions of each model input to predicted burned area.

gallery.title: Wet deposition at monitoring stations
gallery.description: NH₄⁺ and NO₃⁻ predictions compared with observations in the archived Fire_Ndep v20260403 station experiment C_16_era5_gdp_mask.
gallery.alt: Scatterplots comparing predicted and observed ammonium and nitrate at monitoring stations.
